label: Neutral
note: Fading fear (unconfirmed) (day 6 of stress, VIX high 35.9): The VIX is 15%+ below its high, but credit is still widening, the market made a new low or it is in a bear market: in 2008 and 2022 such pauses came before further falls. Variance risk premium (HAR) higher than 2% of the last 10 years. VIX above VIX3M: the term structure is inverted, a sign of near-term stress.
method: Fear score = 0.3 × (3 + 4 × HAR variance-risk-premium percentile over 10 years) + 0.7 × fear-phase score (calm 5, early fear 5 + risk flag, peak stress 5.5, fading fear 7.5 if confirmed by credit, no new low and no bear state, else 5.5, after fear 4.5). Per stock: 5 + (score − 5) × clip(beta, 0.5, 1.5), 10% of entry timing. Holdout-tested on 2007–2016.
